_comment: Chatterbox TTS (Resemble AI, MIT) - local narration + zero-shot voice cloning. To clone a voice, add a LoadAudio node with 10-20s of clean reference speech and wire it into node 1's optional `audio_prompt` input. exaggeration 0.25 = flat/documentary, 0.5 = natural, 1.0+ = theatrical. cfg_weight lower = slower and more deliberate delivery. First run downloads the model weights (~2GB) automatically.

inputs.text: For thirty years the station listened, and heard nothing. On the last night, something answered.
